exposure: Women with PCOS only (reference group) vs. women with both PCOS and endometriosis (study group)
Presence of both polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) and endometriosis
cohort: Women with PCOS, with a study group of 163 having both PCOS and endometriosis and a reference group of 14,719 having PCOS without endometriosis
finding: Women with both PCOS and endometriosis experienced higher rates of placental abruption, cesarean deliveries, and venous thromboembolisms compared to women with PCOS alone.
mod_finding: Women with PCOS and endometriosis had a higher likelihood of Cesarean section.
